content:
Jess: Heads-up — seeing a batch of GPU alloc fails in us-west2 for the last ~20m. provisioning error: local NVMe IO saturation.
ops-bot: [ALERT] gpu-provisioner us-west2: 12 failed attaches in 10m (root cause: block_device IO write backpressure)
Ryan: what triggered the IO spike?
Jess: digging logs, appears to coincide with janitor job deleting lots of tiny tmp files on scratchpool. huge smallfile churn -> write amplification + scrub starts.
Mira: ugh the new janitor change that removes old /tmp shards? rolled yesterday at 02:00?
Beatrice: yes that change: `find /scratch -type f -mtime +7 -exec rm \;` with parallelism increased to 64. probably too greedy.
Jess: here's a sample from node gnode-usw2-18 syslog: `kernel: nvme0n1: dev qdepth 1024 busy 98% write_lat average 25ms, IO_saturation=true`
k8s-sre: nodes started to show ContainerAttach timeout errors: `AttachVolume attach failed for pod... timeout waiting for volume`
Ryan: consequence: GPU pods stuck in Pending, autoscaler can't place, span to other regions force-migrated some GPU workloads -> cost up.
Mira: quick mitigation: throttle janitor parallelism to 4 and add `ionice -c2 -n7` to the rm process. I'll push a rollback in 5.
Beatrice: also can we exclude scratch devices with high writeback? or target globs to avoid smallfiles.
Jess: meanwhile need to stop scheduling onto impacted nodes. @k8s-sre can you cordon the affected gnodes and drain low-priority?
k8s-sre: cordoning gnode-usw2-[12-20] now. draining non-prod low-priority pods.
ops-bot: [DEPLOY] rollback: janitor v2.3.1 -> v2.3.0 applied by Mira (id: deploy-59321)
Mira: deployed `ionice` + parallelism200->4 patch. monitoring IOPS.
Jess: initial numbers: write_iops dropped from 120k -> 18k, avg write_lat from 25ms -> 6ms. GPU attach failures dropped after cordon/rollback.
Ryan: can we also temporarily route production GPU requests to dedicated pool (dedicated-gpu-usw2) for HA while we stabilize? cost implications but should be short.
Beatrice: confirmed routing rule exists, can enable, takes ~2min to warm. Doing it now.
ops-bot: [ROUTER] route update: route gpu/us-west2 -> dedicated-gpu-usw2 (temporary) by Beatrice
Jess: next steps: schedule a controlled janitor rework — change delete pattern to batch unlink+reflink-aware, add `--min-size` to skip tiny files, add KV of deletion rates to monitor. Also need a firmware/kernel health check for NVMe that may amplify GC.
Mira: opened incident ticket INC-2026 and assigned to infra-oncall. I added logs and graph links.
Ryan: let's also capture cost delta from route to dedicated pool and GPU warm-migrations for billing. cc @finance later.
Beatrice: planning a canary for janitor at 1 host/hour next week, will include ionice and `xargs -n 50 rm` to reduce ops.
Jess: postmortem owners? Mira + Beatrice + Ryan. target writeup by EOD tomorrow so we can sync with infra weekly.
Mira: noted. I'll attach metrics and grep snippets in the ticket.
Jess: thanks all. filing action items: throttle janitor, cordon nodes, route to dedicated, incident ticket, cost tracking, postmortem. :thumbsup:
